newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko Sec sets up U.K. share holding firm.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Sec sets up U.K. share holding firm.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co Ltd said on Friday that it set up a fully-owned holding company in London this month in order to boost efficiency in its seven overseas securities subsidiaries in Western and Asian markets.
The new company, Nikko Securities Global Holdings Ltd, is capitalised at about 41.6 billion yen. It owns a majority stake in the seven firms but does not engage in a specific business.

"We reorganised the structure of overseas arms in order to use our capital more efficiently and to establish a global risk management system. Details of what we will do through the new holding firm will be worked out in future," said a spokesman.

The seven overseas firms under the umbrella of the new holding company are Nikko Europe Plc, Nikko Securities Co International Inc, Nikko Securities Co (Asia), Nikko Bank (Switzerland) Ltd, Nikko Merchant Bank (Singapore) Ltd, Nikko Futures (Singapore) Plc Ltd, and Nikko Securities (Singapore) Plc Ltd, the spokesman said.
